answer: One enforceable rule: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The onyx of work and the kernel of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a echo to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
